exposure: prostaglandin and oxytocin protocol for induction of labor
cohort: The study included 98 women with term premature rupture of membranes and a low BISHOP score from three teaching hospitals of Addis Abeba University.
finding: The prostaglandin and oxytocin protocol for induction of labor significantly reduced the rate of cesarean delivery due to failed labor induction and non-reassuring fetal heart patterns compared to the direct oxytocin protocol.
mod_finding: Prostaglandin cervical ripening reduced the burden of cesarean section in cases of term premature rupture of membranes with low BISHOP score.
cross-section timing: Outcomes were compared between two induction protocols concurrently practiced in the hospitals.
